title: CoBRA: Programming Cognitive Bias in Social Agents Using Classic Social Science Experiments

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM agents using scenario-based prompts adapted from the Milgram Obedience and Stanford Prison classic social science experiments, computing a Cognitive Bias Index from the probability distribution of 5-point multiple-choice responses.
Testing agents' tendency to conform to group consensus or majority behaviors using adaptations of Asch's Line and the Hotel Towel paradigms, measured via multiple-choice response probabilities.

Assessing agents' preference for belief-confirming information using prompt adaptations of the Wason Selection task and Biased Information seeking paradigms, calculating bias indices from response probabilities.
Measuring agents' shifts in risk preferences when identical outcomes are presented under positive versus negative framings, using adaptations of the Asian Disease and Investment/Insurance paradigms.
